name: bishop
description: Ticket-driven Rails workflow: break a new feature into vertical-slice Linear tickets, then work each ticket — read it, clarify the approach, implement in small TDD batches, and run a structured quality gate (tests, RuboCop, RubyCritic, mutation testing, style guide, correctness-vs-ticket check) before calling it done. Also upgrades Expo / React Native apps one SDK hop at a time, guided by each project's upgrade history. Writes client Statements of Work from planned Linear projects.
